charts.description: Pin chart versions for this app.

ingress.description: Namespaces allowed to reach this app.

policy.description: Render the namespace's default-deny network policies. Defaults to true; must be set explicitly with namespace.name.

autoscale.description: Run a HorizontalPodAutoscaler instead of fixed replicas. cpu is the target average utilisation, as a percent of requests. Deployments only.

phase.description: Run the Job as an Argo hook in this sync phase: preSync before anything else applies, postSync once everything is applied and healthy. Required with kind Job.

env.description: Map of variable to a string, {resource, part}, {service, port}, {secret|database|bucket|oidc, key} or {field}. A list is the raw form.

part.description: Part of the resource URL. Defaults to url.

envFrom.description: {secret|database|bucket|oidc: resource name}, or a raw secretRef object.

mounts.description: Keyed by volume name. ConfigMaps mount read-only.

ports.description: {name, container, service}. service adds the port to the workload's Service.

overrides.description: Written directly to the k8s-workload values for this workload.

ports.description: {name, container, service}. service adds the port to the workload's Service.

resources.description: Named dependencies and what the app exposes.

user.description: IAM user name, for s3. Defaults to the bucket name.

secretTemplate.description: Reshape the synced secret, for consumers that expect other keys.

enableConnectionPooling.description: Connect through the pooler. Defaults to true.

role.description: Postgres role and database name. Defaults to the name with hyphens as underscores.

extensions.description: Postgres extensions to ensure are present.

secretTemplate.description: Reshape the synced secret, for consumers that expect other keys.

generate.description: Generate these keys once and keep them in OpenBao at kv/<namespace>/generated/<name>, instead of reading values someone stored.

digits.description: Defaults to a quarter of the length.

instance.description: A cache export in platform/exports. Defaults to cache.

protocol.description: Defaults to http. tcp attaches a TCPRoute to a gateway listener and takes only gateway, listener, backend and auth.

listener.description: TCP listener on the gateway, for tcp.

auth.description: How this route authenticates. jwt and oidc are enforced at the gateway; app and none need a reason.

clients.description: oidc clients whose tokens are accepted, for jwt.

client.description: oidc client with a securityPolicy targeting this route, for oidc.

reason.description: Why the gateway does not authenticate, for app and none.

jwt.description: Verify the login token at the gateway, for oidc.

header.description: Limit each distinct value of this request header.

loadBalancer.description: How the gateway spreads requests across the backend. headers picks the hash inputs for consistentHash.

rules.description: Send paths to different backends. Replaces paths and backend.

dns.description: Publish the route's hosts in DNS.

files.description: Relative to the app directory. Mounted at the same relative path; the key is the basename.

secretName.description: Render the files as go templates into this secret, which is mounted instead of the configmap. Needs values.

values.description: Template variables, read as {{ .NAME }}, taken from a key of a secret, database, bucket or oidc resource.

file.description: Grafana dashboard json, relative to the app directory.

claimName.description: Name of the persistent volume claim.

oneOf.description: Registers this app's GraphQL API as a federation subgraph of the app declaring a supergraph.

prefix.description: Prefix every root field of this subgraph must start with, e.g. home -> homeEntities.

port.description: Port name or service port on that workload.

websocket.description: Subscriptions endpoint, when the subgraph has subscriptions.

auth.description: Early check at the router: operations against this subgraph, and its part of introspection, need a Kanidm JWT from one of clients holding one of groups. The subgraph still authorizes on its own.

clients.description: Kanidm OIDC clients (oidc resource names, in any app) whose tokens the router accepts for this subgraph.

groups.description: Kanidm groups, short name or SPN; holding any one of them is enough.

repository.description: https://<host>/<owner>/<repo> holding the federation SDL. Leave out with ref to read schema from the app directory.

schema.description: Path to the federation SDL in the repository, or relative to the app directory when repository is left out.

ref.description: Branch or tag to read the SDL from; required with repository.

oneOf.description: Marks this app as the federation router; `ortzi app supergraph` composes every subgraph into it.

base.description: Hand-written router config the generated router.yaml extends; router.yaml, supergraph.graphql, schema.graphql and subgraphs/ are written beside it.

exports.description: Workloads other apps can use as a resource.

sources.description: What the app deploys beyond its workloads and resources.

values.description: Values file, relative to the app directory.

releaseName.description: Defaults to the app name. Required when a chart is listed twice.

path.description: Kustomization directory, relative to the app directory. Use . for the app directory.

overrides.description: Change what one output generates. Keyed by output, then generated object. Every block is validated, even for outputs that are not active.

automated.description: Sync automatically with prune and self-heal. Defaults to true.

paths.description: Extra paths that trigger a build.

name.description: Deploy into this existing namespace instead of one named after the app.

labels.description: Applied through k8s-workload, or managedNamespaceMetadata for an app with no workloads.
